strings.en: There... I'll take that...
That position... is a bad one.
Keep... the change.
Here I go...
Well then, shall we begin?
I'll be going first.
The bell has rung.
I'll hit you...
That's mine...
Well then, here I go...
I can't be your playmate.
You'll get more than burned.
Glory and ruin are two sides of the same coin.
Then you truly won't be able to go back.
You have doubts, don't you?
The thorn is lodged in your heart.
Are you satisfied with how you are now...?
I'll be passing through, if you please.
There are people calling for you...
You can't be a gatekeeper.
You're only being manipulated by fate, too...
Money doesn't solve everything, you know.
Somehow, your vibe is easy to match.
You have a heart, yet you'd throw it away?
You don't hold the Key to the Gate.
Getting too fat isn't good for you.
Let's have a magic contest.
I remember that one.
There won't be a second time.
It's best not to get close.
I won't become a puppet.
So you've been manipulated too.
What a shiny, pretty body you have.
First, I'll cut off the tail.
You look like Person-Lichkeit.
You may look like Person, but we can't be friends.
We've only just met, yet I feel/　as though I already knew you.
Perhaps... we share the same roots.
I'll be your opponent.
I won't let you go any further.
The way home is over there, Fury.
Fury, your wish won't come true.
I'll pull the thorns out cleanly.
You feel like someone I know.
Let's run away, quickly.
Such a big scythe... Person can't lose to that.
That is a mass of malice...
There's no end to them here.
That's something different from the Einst or Ruina...
It's an enemy all the same, that's how it is.
Don't slip up, Alchemie.
I know.
This is a sensation I can't get used to.
There's no need to be afraid.
Let's go, Axel.
Right. I'll leave it to you.
I'm not the same as you anymore...
We can't leave that alone.
What a half-formed existence...
So they get stronger when they Combine.
A Lamaris King, so to speak.
Even that is still half-formed...
Even after growing that big,/　something is still missing...
You've grown up so grand...
What you're seeking now is...
What is it you want to do...?/　What is your true wish?
It's a problem if you stay there.
What I've received... I must return.
A woman always repays her debts.../　Repays... her debts...?
There's... no second time.
...Shall we... make a bet...?
Let me thank you...
See... you're in range.
Your destination has already been decided, you know?
Payback, double over, as they say.
I'll chase you wherever you go.
Kyosuke... Kyo...suke...?
Not yet...
Pierced...?! I can still... move...
That power... is dangerous.
It's growing stronger...?
I can still keep you company...
This... calls for more than double payback.
...That's not like you, Alchemie.
I think so too.
You can't drink my blood, you know?
I won't be beaten, Lamaris...
It's no use trying to absorb Person.
That... rather stings.
Float like a butterfly, sting like a.../　...Oh. I've been hit...
It's not that I was careless...
That... rather hurts.
I don't care for this kind of violence.
Seems we're still fine.
I'd like you to praise Person.
I have no intention of amusing you.
...The momentum of youth, I see.
You're not serious, are you?
What is this odd feeling...?
...If you stay like that, the Gate will swallow you.
...I couldn't see through the trick.
...Should I shine a bright light on you?
You were after the humans from the very start...?!
...What a sharp thorn.
I won't be tainted by the likes of you.
Fused malice is dangerous.
The malice is growing even stronger...
...What is it you want to become?
Things aren't... going well.
...That startled me a little.
I'm still all right.
I dislike... noise.
Is that... all?
Roughness isn't nice, you know?
I'd rather do the chasing than be chased.
Axel, are you all right?
Yeah. Dodge the next one, would you?
I won't give you the screams you like.
You lack experience.
Grudges and spite alone won't do.
You're actually a kind person, aren't you?
The black thorns aren't much after all.
What goes around comes around... You'll learn soon.
I've seen your magic now.
It doesn't matter to you what I am, does it?
These thorns don't hurt so much.
I don't want to be friends with you.
You can't swallow me, you know?
Just like Jetzt.
That won't hit me. Farewell...
Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee.
If I move early...
That movement... I can read it...
Things won't go the way you want.
I dodged it just for you.
Would it have hit if I hadn't been aboard?
It's no use aiming at me, Fury.
Thorns won't pierce me.
It's no use trying to possess me.
You won't catch me anymore.
The folly of youth, I see.
I can see you're impatient.
You can't obtain the Gate.
Too bad...
Good girl, Person.
Now that you're bigger, you can't turn so sharply.
So you are wavering, after all.
A woman's heart is complicated.
You don't know how to treat a lady.
Your aim isn't as precise as Excellen's.
Person was red to begin with.
What happens twice won't happen a third time.
Is the magic show over?
You don't talk much, do you?
We may look alike, but we can't be friends.
I wonder why... Seeing XN-L makes me feel uneasy.
How dazzling...
Flicker... flicker...
Goodbye...
I can't... do anything...?
Not... strong enough...?
I can't... lay a hand on them...?
Yes... I'll support you.
What a fine position.
Please save some for me too.
Please take me on as well.
Kyosuke... I'm coming too.
Excellen... I'll leave the rest to you.
Axel... allow me to assist you.
Axel... we're always together.
Allow me to assist the "Key."
Haken, I'll help you.
Pardon my intrusion...
Please step back...
I want you to look at me.
I'll do my part here.
Axel... no reckless stunts, please.
You and I... were one and the same, yes?
Haken, no looking away.
All at once... here I go.
That position... is very bad for you.
Once more.
How lucky.
This is self-support.
That formation... is mine.
So bright...
With this...
Now you'll disappear.
I can see it...
Your fate...
And this... is the end.
Are you... prepared?
Farewell...
Quick and easy... quick and easy... here I go.
Gently... gently... I'll do it.
To your body... and your soul...
